verdict.rationale: SavvyCal exposes a REST/JSON API with OAuth and personal access tokens (and a confirmed OpenAPI spec) that could be used to pull out scheduling links, events, and webhook data programmatically, but there is no documented bulk 'export all your data' feature, no GDPR-style data export tool, and no mention of open-format full account export or data portability upon leaving. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/portability documentation, bulk export tooling, and confirmation that all user data (not just API-accessible objects) can be retrieved in an open format.
